title: My first indie game, Bollum! Here's my first jungle environment prototype 🌴
author: Sashamirae17
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'm currently working on **Bollum**, my first indie game, a 2.5D physics-based platformer inspired by classic Bounce-style games.

The game is being developed in **Unreal Engine 5**, and I've been spending a lot of time working on the physics, movement, jumping mechanics, collisions, and other gameplay systems.

Now I'm finally starting to work on the visual side of the game! 🌴

I've just put together my **first jungle environment prototype**, testing a few 3D assets, including:

🌿 Tropical platforms with grass, rocks, and vegetation  
🌳 Jungle trees  
🔴 The main character (a red ball)  
🟡 Golden checkpoint rings

Everything is still in the early stages, so **this is definitely not the final visual quality**. I'm experimenting with different assets, colors, and environments to find the right look for the game.

🎥 **Here's a video showing the first prototype:**  
[https://www.youtube.com/@VornumStudios](https://www.youtube.com/@VornumStudios)

I've also started a small YouTube channel where I'm documenting the development process, sharing progress, new features, bugs, fixes, and experiments.

I'd really love to hear your thoughts!

* What do you think of the visual style so far?
* Is there anything you'd improve or change?
* Do you have any suggestions for making the environment feel more alive?



And if you find the project interesting, **consider subscribing to my YouTube channel** to follow its development. Even a little support is incredibly motivating! ❤️

Thanks for checking it out! 🎮
